case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer of €138.55 per unit and for explaining the increases in LCI-C and PPI-C241. We appreciate the care your foundry brings to our volute casings and the reliable cooperation between our companies. We have also considered the development of another index. The index PPI-D351 changed -3.7 % from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). In light of this, our counterproposal is EUR 127.89 per unit, payment 14 days net, valid from 2027-04-01. We hope these terms provide a sound basis for continuing our cooperation and would welcome your thoughts.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €140.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your offer of 14-day payment terms and have factored this into our calculation.
However, we cannot delay the adjustment until April 2027; we propose a fair compromise of €136.50 effective 1 January 2027.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your reply and for revising your proposal in light of the index data and our proposed payment terms. We appreciate your explanation of the remaining cost pressures and your alternative price effective 1 January 2027.

Your letter doc:20260911-70110-P01 gives us 51 days of notice, while our agreement ctr:4600070110 requires 90 days. For that reason, we cannot agree to the earlier adjustment. In recognition of your position, we can improve our offer to EUR 130.55 per unit, payment 14 days net, valid from 2027-04-01. Would you be willing to meet us on this basis?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
